title: Randomized clinical trial to compare oral isotretinoin to standard of care in moderate acne skin of color patients
official: Randomized clinical trial to compare oral isotretinoin to standard of care in moderate acne skin of color patients
summary: Main objective: To assess the superiority at M6 of an early treatment of moderate facial acne in skin of color patients of oral isotretinoin compared to the current standard of care on the severity of ARP

interventions.name: LYMECYCLINE ARROW 408 mg (équivalent à 300 mg de tétracycline base), gélule

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Women and men between 13 and 30-year-old
2. Skin type IV, V and VI according to Fitzpatrick skin types
3. Moderate acne as defined by the French Society of Dermatology recommendations based on ECLA grading https://document.sfdermato.org/groupe/centre-de-preuves/label-recommandations-acne-post-college.pdf)
4. Patients must have a cell phone able to take selfies pictures with a minimum definition of 5Mb.
5. Signed informed consent
6. Affiliation to French social coverage
Exclusion criteria:
1. Mild and severe acne (ECLA grading : French recommendations) (https://document.sfdermato.org/groupe/centre-de-preuves/label-recommandations-acne-post-college.pdf)
2. Vulnerable people: adult under guardianship or deprived of freedom
3. Past cure of oral isotretinoin
4. Past cure of systemic antibiotics for acne in the last 6 months
5. Phototype I-III patients
6. Abnormal hemogram, liver enzyme, cholesterol, triglycerides at baseline
7. Pregnancy: female patient of childbearing potential will undergo a pregnancy test (plasmatic β-hCG)
8. Breast-feeding patients
9. Refusal of effective contraception for women
10. Contra-indications to oral isotretinoin, doxycycline, lymecycline, topical adapalene/tretinoin
